messages:
jordan: Heads up — noticed a 42k GPU charge spike overnight attributed to project nimbus-prod-2 in GCP. Didn’t match our expected daily baseline.
maria: whoa. Is that the prod customer workload or a sandbox job? :eyes:
jordan: appears to be a long-running training job started at ~02:10 UTC. Labels are missing: no 'team' or 'customer' tag on the VM resource.
ashok: pinging infra — do we have autoscale or runaway retries on that cluster? I can look at autoscaler logs but need the instance ids.
jordan: I pulled the charge rows from the billing export:

```
SELECT sku, usage_start_time, project, resource_name, labels
FROM gcp_billing_export
WHERE project = 'nimbus-prod-2' AND usage_start_time >= '2026-03-21'
ORDER BY usage_start_time DESC
LIMIT 50;
```

Result shows multiple preemptible-interruptions + recovery loop across 6 GPUs.
zoe: can you paste the instance names? I’ll try to correlate with our orchestration logs.
jordan: instance names: nimbus-train-021, nimbus-train-022, nimbus-train-023. They spun up 2026-03-21T02:06 -> 2026-03-21T11:02.
ashok: that timeline matches a batch job we recently allowed to burst during off-peak for a pricing experiment. Did we forget a max-runtime guard? :grimacing:
maria: not ideal — if experiment runaway, we need to charge back to the customer or apply internal budget. What’s the customer on the contract? finance-pm: Nimbus (startup tier), contract says limited credits per month; overages billed.
finance-pm: We need three things: 1) short-term credit hold / invoice note, 2) re-cost attribution (team vs customer), 3) retroactive tagging for backfill in billing pipeline.
jordan: I propose: mark this spend as customer-overage for Nimbus, bill on next invoice, and reimburse internal experiment budget up to 10k. Remaining 32k billed to Nimbus. Need approval from @finance-pm and product.
finance-pm: approve provisional split (10k internal, rest customer). Please create an invoice note and tag the billing rows. I'll review before sending.
ashok: operational action items:
- stop the running jobs (I’ve paused the orchestration pool) ✅
- add a max-runtime guard on the batch orchestrator (PR in flight) — @zoe please review
- ensure autoscaler backoff fixed
- add alert for >$5k untagged GPU spend within 6h
zoe: will review PR in the next hour. Also can backfill labels using the instance metadata + Github run id mapping, then re-ingest to billing pipeline. I’ll need the mapping from Jordan.
jordan: mapping pasted to internal gist — will DM. For billing backfill, here's the CSV I'll push to the pipeline:

```
resource_name,labels.team,labels.customer,usage_start,usage_end,cost
nimbus-train-021,ml-team,Nimbus,2026-03-21T02:06,2026-03-21T11:02,10500
nimbus-train-022,ml-team,Nimbus,2026-03-21T02:09,2026-03-21T10:58,16500
nimbus-train-023,ml-team,Nimbus,2026-03-21T02:12,2026-03-21T11:00,15000
```

maria: when you re-ingest, please tag the invoice line with NOTE: "provisional split 10k Redwood internal, remainder charged to Nimbus — subject to review" so accounting tracks it.
finance-pm: will add an invoice memo. Also cc’ing legal for customer communication draft.
billing-bot: Automated action: created billing adjustment ticket #BILL-3419 and assigned to finance-pm.
zoe: quick ask — can we add this scenario to the pricing experiment runbook? Add a check that prevents experiments from exceeding a per-project spend cap.
ashok: agreed. I’ll add alert tuning too.
jordan: thanks all. I’ll stop the remaining pods and push the backfill CSV to the pipeline within 30m. Will follow up with a summary for the invoice thread.
maria: thanks — keep me posted. :thumbsup:
finance-pm: noted. Once backfill is complete and the draft invoice memo written, I’ll sign off and send notice to Nimbus support.
thread_summary: GPU spend spike in 'nimbus-prod-2' due to a burst batch training experiment with missing labels; agreed provisional cost split (10k internal, remainder billed to customer), actions: stop jobs, backfill labels, create billing adjustment ticket, add alerts and runbook safeguards.
